## Highlights
### Fixed
- You can now add a search provider whose address puts the search after a #, such as PubChem’s. - With Shift chosen in Settings > Links > Open Peek with, Shift-click now opens links in Peek on the Chromium engine instead of a new tab. - On the Chromium engine, a link that opens a new window now opens in the Peek or Quick Window it was clicked in. - On the Chromium engine, a new-window link in a Peek or Quick Window now loads once, and still tells the site which page it came from. - Extension popups, such as a password manager's, now stay open while macOS asks for Touch ID or another app is in front, so unlocking with Touch ID completes. - Clicking an extension's icon while its popup is open now closes the popup instead of opening it again. - Crest on Mac no longer quits when a Chromium tab opens the new tab page, as Claude in Chrome does, or keeps quitting at launch while restoring one. - The new tab page in a Chromium tab no longer quits Crest on Mac when it would offer to customize the page.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
